engine: rhasspy piper (local). Models installed in ~/.local/share/atlas/piper/: en_GB-vctk-medium (109 speakers; use the 'speaker' key, resolved via the model's speaker_id_map), en_GB-northern_english_male-medium, en_GB-southern_english_female-low, en_GB-cori-medium, en_US-ryan-medium, en_US-joe-medium, en_US-lessac-medium, it_IT-riccardo-x_low. en_GB-alba-medium and en_US-hfc_female-medium are NOT installed and are not used.
piper_params: length_scale (>1 slower), noise_scale (expressiveness; KEEPER 0.30), noise_w (duration variation). pitch_semitones is applied in post (e.g. sox/rubberband), not by Piper.

dry.desc: No processing. KEEPER's voice: flat, close, no room.

helmet.desc: PIONEER-1 inside the suit: clean close-mic with a light helmet reverb and the faint breath bed.
chain: breath bed -32 dB (removed after the filter burns out)

grille.desc: Caretaker speaker grille: filtered, slightly metallic. The filter's idea of a robot.

unfiltered.desc: A caretaker heard WITHOUT the filter (glitch frames in Act IV, everything after the burn): the same take, dry and human.

memory.desc: Flashback audio (DAD, ALICE, LUCY, shards): warm, slightly soft, remembered.

broadcast.desc: ARCHITECT and the 2059 advert: compressed, polished, aged by the archive.
chain: for the 2059 advert add wow 0.4% and 10 kHz lowpass

live.desc: Real humans in air (Act V dome): no filter, room tone. The first live voices in the game.

corrupted.desc: PIONEER-3's mainframe: skips, loops, stutters, rare lucid moments.

intercom.desc: The old outpost intercom (C15): small speaker, telephone band.

phone.desc: A 2040s mobile voicemail: codec band, slight artefacts.

archive.desc: 2056 ESI interview footage: camera mic in a plain room.

radio.desc: Radio links: RELAY, RECALL teams in the field, the pioneer network.

signed.desc: HUSH signs: never rendered; shown as subtitles in square brackets.

player_voice.rule: P1, DAD, P1_MEM, PIONEER_3, PIONEER_11 and PIONEER_N are 'player' voices: render once per selectable preset. PIONEER_3 must always match the player's pick exactly. ROWAN is always the default preset.

default.speaker: p298
default.accent: Irish (Tipperary speaker standing in for Galway)

P1.speaker: p298
P1.brief: Player-selected preset. Close, tired, dry humour, a geologist's precision. Whispers the poem.
P1.story_rule: Same voice reused for every pioneer. Rendered once per selectable preset.

P1_MEM.speaker: p298
P1_MEM.brief: PIONEER-1's voice inside a remembered scene that is Rowan's real life (UB, Galway, phone calls). Younger, unguarded.
P1_MEM.story_rule: Always the player's chosen P1 voice.

DAD.speaker: p298
DAD.brief: PIONEER-1's own voice as remembered: softer, bedtime register.
DAD.story_rule: Always the player's chosen P1 voice, never a separate actor.

PIONEER_3.speaker: p298
PIONEER_3.brief: Identical to P1's chosen preset. Warped and skipping.
PIONEER_3.story_rule: Must always match the player's choice; heard only in C10.

PIONEER_11.speaker: p298
PIONEER_11.brief: P1's voice, certain and cheerful. The loyal one.
PIONEER_11.story_rule: Same voice as P1. Over the network use radio.

PIONEER_N.speaker: p298
PIONEER_N.brief: Pioneers 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12 on the network: P1's voice, different lives.

ROWAN.speaker: p298
ROWAN.brief: Galway man in his late thirties, nervous. 2056 archive footage.
ROWAN.story_rule: Always the DEFAULT P1 voice, whatever the player picked: this is where the default came from.

KEEPER.brief: Neutral, precise, polite, no emotion. Never stresses a word.
KEEPER.story_rule: Never lies; answers only the literal question.

ANVIL.speaker: p292
ANVIL.brief: Belfast, late 20s, gravel, quick wit. Warm under the jokes. (VCTK p292 is a Belfast male in his twenties; -0.5 st adds the grit without ageing him. Same speaker as DES, on purpose.)
ANVIL.story_rule: Calls itself a unit until named. Human (unfiltered) in glitch frames and after the burn.

LODESTONE.speaker: p314
LODESTONE.brief: Quiet, exact, pedantic about rocks; competitive with P1's geology.
LODESTONE.accent_note: No Nigerian English Piper voice installed; VCTK p314 (South African female), slowed, is the nearest non-British stand-in. Replace when a voice exists.

WELLSPRING.speaker: p239
WELLSPRING.accent: South-west England standing in for Cornish
WELLSPRING.brief: Cornish, 30s, careful, anxious, counts things twice.
WELLSPRING.accent_note: No Cornish speaker in VCTK; p239 (SW England) is closest.

BEACON.brief: Relentless optimist; harbour-pilot memories; talks about weather like the sea.
BEACON.accent_note: No Portuguese-English voice; joe-medium brightened is a stand-in.

CADENCE.speaker: p253
CADENCE.brief: Welsh, 20s, bright; sings on the open channel.
CADENCE.story_rule: Songs repeat exactly across all CADENCE units. Sung lines need a singer or music asset; TTS speaks only the spoken lines.

SUTURE.speaker: p276
SUTURE.brief: Dry, clinical, ICU-nurse calm; mercy in what she leaves unsaid.
SUTURE.accent_note: No Polish-English voice; p276 read flat is a stand-in.

GIRDER.speaker: p237
GIRDER.brief: Cheerful about heights he is terrified of.

KILN.speaker: p256
KILN.brief: Big plans, soft voice; wants to print a cathedral.

LANTERN.speaker: p234
LANTERN.brief: Night-shift astronomer; precise, curious, a little reckless.

SCRIBE.brief: Archivist; careful with words, proud of the plaque.

WARDEN.speaker: p232
WARDEN.brief: Correct, loyal to Meridian, cold when it counts.

MORTAR_1.speaker: p270
MORTAR_1.brief: Stonemason's patience; stories with no endings.

MORTAR_2.speaker: p270
MORTAR_2.brief: The same donor, slightly different life.
MORTAR_2.story_rule: Same donor as MORTAR_1: per-unit pitch variation only.

CARD.brief: Epilogue cards and on-screen text. Never rendered.

ALICE.speaker: p340
ALICE.brief: Eight, curious, asks impossible questions about Mars.
ALICE.story_rule: Same takes heard by all pioneers. Child voice is a pitch-shifted adult take: audition, or replace with a recorded performance.

DES.speaker: p292
DES.brief: Des at 28 on a voicemail: ANVIL's voice without the years or the grille.
DES.story_rule: Same speaker as ANVIL, no pitch drop.

ARCHITECT.brief: Polished, corporate, sincere. Believes every word.

CITS_PA.brief: Meridian public address in the Act V cities.

COVENANT_LEAD.speaker: p280
COVENANT_LEAD.accent: French (VCTK p280, a French speaker reading English)
COVENANT_LEAD.story_rule: First live human voice in the game.
COVENANT_LEAD.accent_note: Kept on VCTK p280 (a French speaker reading English) with the live preset, as the bible asks (live, no filter). it_IT-riccardo-x_low is male and low quality; not used for her. If p280 auditions badly, fall back to en_GB-southern_english_female-low with pitch -1.

CARA.speaker: p261
CARA.brief: 67, precise, guarded; goes cold at Rowan's name.

GEN1.brief: Gen-1 drone log playback: flatter than KEEPER, slower, degraded.

GALE_ANVIL.speaker: p292
GALE_ANVIL.brief: Pioneer-5's ANVIL: the same voice (Belfast, late 20s), the same jokes, no memory of P1.
GALE_ANVIL.story_rule: MUST be the exact ANVIL voice: that is the point.

UNIT.brief: Generated caretaker: voice comes from its donor template in population.json.
UNIT.story_rule: speaker field reads UNIT:<template id>, e.g. UNIT:T14

population_voices: Generated caretakers use their donor template's voice (population.json templates[].voice) with the grille preset and per-unit variation.
